name: pr-weather
description: The CI weather of your firstmate fleet's open PRs, one glyph per PR in the band above the prompt

source.title: PR source
source.description: fleet: the PRs in the firstmate fleet ledger (shown in firstmate sessions). mine: your open PRs in the session's repository (shown in any git repository).

mode.title: Refresh mode
mode.description: auto: refresh on the interval below. manual: load once when the session starts, then refresh only from the band's refresh button or /pr-weather refresh. The band's mode button overrides this until you change it here.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often auto mode asks GitHub for fresh PR weather. It waits longer while the GitHub quota is low.

home.title: Firstmate home
home.description: The firstmate home whose fleet ledger to read (fleet source). Empty: the nearest one at or above the session's working directory. When set, the band shows in every session.

includeSecondMates.title: Include second mates
includeSecondMates.description: Also show the PRs in the fleet ledgers of the second mate homes registered in the firstmate home's data/secondmates.md that exist on this machine (fleet source).
